sections.description:
Transform your WordPress site’s performance with WBN Image Optimizer – the only free plugin combining advanced image optimization with intelligent unused image detection.

Why Choose WBN Image Optimizer

Industry-First Free Scanner
Find and remove images consuming storage but not displayed anywhere on your site. No other free plugin offers this capability.

Transparent Pricing
100 lifetime optimizations – not 20/month that resets. No pressure tactics, no hidden costs. Simple and honest.

Modern Format Support
Convert images to WebP (60-70% smaller) or AVIF (up to 80% smaller) while maintaining visual quality that satisfies both users and search engines.

Professional-Grade Safety
Every optimization includes automatic backup. Restore any image to its original state with one click – zero risk to your content.

Core Features

Unused Image Scanner
Intelligent detection of images consuming storage without being displayed:
* Featured images and thumbnails
* WooCommerce product galleries and variations
* Gallery shortcodes and image blocks
* Post and page content
* Site icons, logos, and widgets
* Custom post types and ACF fields

* Gallery (1600×1600px) – Balanced quality for photo galleries, WebP format, Quality 80

Advanced Format Conversion

* Automatic fallbacks for older browsers

Enterprise-Level Safety

Flexible Control

Performance Impact

Real-world results from WBN Image Optimizer users:
* 40-60% reduction in page load time

* 30-50% savings on bandwidth costs
* Improved SEO rankings from faster pages
* Enhanced user experience with instant image loading

Everyone Else

For Developers

Action Hooks

do_action('wbio_lite_before_optimize', $image_id);

// After optimization

// Before deletion

// After deletion

Filter Hooks

// Modify settings

// Custom Scanner logic

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Navigate to Plugins > Add New in WordPress admin
  2. Search for “WBN Image Optimizer”
  3. Click Install Now on the WBN Image Optimizer plugin
  4. Click Activate once installation completes
  5. Access via Image Optimizer in your admin sidebar

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the downloaded ZIP file
  4. Click Install Now
  5. Click Activate Plugin

Quick Start Guide

Optimize Your First Images
1. Go to Image Optimizer > Optimize
2. Click Select Images from Media Library
3. Choose images to optimize
4. Select a Smart Preset or customize manually
5. Click Optimize Selected Images
6. Done – automatic backups created

Scan for Unused Images
1. Go to Image Optimizer > Scanner
2. Click Scan for Unused Images
3. Review results with thumbnails
4. Select images to remove
5. Click Delete Selected
6. Confirm deletion
7. Storage space freed
sections.faq:
Is this plugin truly free?

Yes. You receive 100 lifetime optimizations plus unlimited Scanner usage – completely free, forever. No credit card required, no trial period. The Pro version exists for users needing higher monthly quotas or multi-site licensing.

How is this different from other image optimizers?

Three key differentiators:
1. Unique Scanner – Only free plugin with unused image detection
2. Honest Quota – 100 lifetime optimizations, not deceptive monthly resets
3. Modern Formats – Both WebP and AVIF support in free version

Most competitors charge for the Scanner, limit format options, or use misleading quota systems.

Are my original images safe?

Completely safe. Every optimization creates an automatic backup before processing. You can restore any image to its exact original state with one click from the Media Library. Zero risk to your content.

What is the difference between WebP and AVIF?

WebP – Developed by Google, 95%+ browser support. Typically 60-70% smaller than JPEG with equivalent visual quality. Safe choice for all sites.

AVIF – Next-generation format with up to 80% size reduction. Browser support currently ~85% and growing. WordPress automatically provides fallbacks for older browsers.

Recommendation: Use WebP for maximum compatibility, AVIF for maximum compression. Both are safe – WordPress handles unsupported browsers automatically.

How does the Unused Image Scanner work?

The Scanner performs comprehensive analysis of your Media Library against site content:

Detection Methods
* Database queries for featured image assignments
* WooCommerce product gallery attachments
* Gallery shortcodes and image block references
* Post and page content image URLs
* Site icon and custom logo settings
* Widget image assignments
* Theme customizer images

Safety Features
The Scanner never deletes automatically. You review all results and manually select which images to remove. All deletions include automatic backups.

Can I optimize previously uploaded images?

Yes. WBN Image Optimizer works with all Media Library images regardless of upload date. Perfect for existing sites with thousands of legacy images.

Will this work with my theme?

Yes. The plugin integrates directly with WordPress’s native Media Library. Compatible with all themes and confirmed working with:
* WooCommerce and variations
* Elementor, Beaver Builder, Divi
* Advanced Custom Fields (ACF)
* WPML and multilingual sites
* WP All Import
* Multisite networks

Does this work with WooCommerce?

Absolutely. The Products (1200×1600) preset is specifically tuned for WooCommerce product images, maintaining detail for zoom functionality while optimizing file size. Store owners typically see 40-60% faster product page loads.

What happens when I reach 100 optimizations?

You’ve used your lifetime allocation. Three options:
1. Continue using Scanner – Unlimited and always free
2. Optimize manually with other tools
3. Upgrade to Pro for 120/month

The plugin continues working normally. The Scanner remains fully functional forever.

Can I restore images after optimization?

Yes, instantly. Every optimized image has a “Restore Original” button in Media Library. One click restores the exact original file – dimensions, quality, format, metadata. Backups are permanent unless manually deleted.

Will optimization slow down my site?

No. Optimization occurs in the admin dashboard, not on the frontend. Visitors never wait for processing.

Visitor Experience
* 40-60% faster page loads
* Instant image rendering
* Lower bandwidth consumption
* Better mobile performance

Admin Experience
* Brief processing time during optimization
* Zero frontend impact

What are the system requirements?

Minimum
* PHP 7.4 or higher
* WordPress 5.0+
* GD or Imagick image library

Recommended
* PHP 8.0+ for optimal performance
* Modern hosting (SiteGround, WP Engine, Kinsta)
* 128MB+ PHP memory limit for bulk operations

Works on shared hosting, VPS, and dedicated servers. No special configuration required.

Is this compatible with WordPress Multisite?

Yes. Each site receives independent quota:
* 100 lifetime optimizations per site
* Separate Scanner per Media Library
* Network admin monitoring
* Individual site admin control

How do I upgrade to Pro?

Visit webnest.co.il/product/wbn-image-optimizer-pro/

After purchase, you receive a license key via email. Enter it in Image Optimizer > Settings and click “Activate License”. Pro features unlock immediately with no data loss.

Do you offer refunds?

Yes. 30-day money-back guarantee on all Pro plans. Contact us within 30 days for a full refund, no questions asked.

Where can I get support?

Free Version
* Support Forum
* Documentation
* Video Tutorials

Pro Version
* Direct email support (same-day response)
* Priority ticket system
* Phone and video call support
* Dedicated account manager (Agency plans)
